faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher (Genetics and Plant Breeding), 1 Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher (Vegetable Science), 1 Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher (Soil Science), 1 Guest Teacher / Part Time Teacher (Agricultural Statistics).

faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form for Guest / Part Time Teacher attached to the advertisement (pages 4 to 6)) and send it to DEAN, College of Agriculture & Research Station, Village-Pandripani, Post Office - Brangjor, Tehsil - Kunkuri, District - Jashpur (C.G.) 496225, by registered post/speed post, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master degree in the relevant subject of Agriculture/Veterinary Science with 55% marks (or equivalent grade 6.50 in 10.0 scale) with good academic record; NET with one NAAS-related journal publication compulsory for Master's degree holders; NET can be waived for Ph.D. holders with UGC Regulation 2009 course work and at least two full length publications with NAAS rating not less than 4. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. To teach B.Sc. Ag. (Hons.) under graduate degree programme.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. degree holders without course work do not qualify for NET exemption. Candidates who do not bring original documents on 02/12/2026 will not be eligible to appear in interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Publication of eligible and non eligible list. Objections/claims by email. Updated eligible and non eligible list. Document verification and Interview by the committee.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary; no right to claim regular appointment. Contractual for one academic session or till appointment of regular teacher, whichever is earlier. Services can be withdrawn by one week notice if performance is unsatisfactory.
